BucketACL.description_en:
The access permissions of the bucket. Valid values:
public-read-write: public-read-write
public-read: public-read
private (default): private

For more information about bucket ACLs, see [Settings for bucket access permissions]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/31843.html）
BucketACL.description_zh:
Bucket的访问权限ACL。取值范围如下：
public-read-write：公共读写
public-read：公共读
private（默认）：私有

关于Bucket访问权限ACL的更多信息，请参见[设置存储空间访问权限ACL]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/31843.html）
BucketACL.title: The access control list (ACL) for a bucket.

description_en: Sets or modifies the access permissions (ACL) of a bucket
description_zh: 设置或修改存储空间（Bucket）的访问权限（ACL）
name: PutBucketAcl

parameters.help_en:
Sets the access control list (ACL) of the bucket. The PutBucketAcl operation uses the x-oss-acl request header in the PUT request to set the access permissions. If this request header is not included, the access permissions settings do not take effect.
Valid values: public-read-write: All users have read and write access permissions on the files in the bucket. Exercise caution when you set this ACL. public-read: The bucket owner and authorized users have read and write access permissions on the files in the bucket. Other users have only read permissions on the files in the bucket. Exercise caution when you set this ACL. private: The bucket owner and authorized users have read and write access permissions on the files in the bucket. Other users cannot access the files in the bucket
parameters.help_zh:
设置Bucket的访问权限ACL。PutBucketAcl接口通过Put请求中的x-oss-acl请求头来设置访问权限，如果没有该请求头，则访问权限设置不生效。
取值如下： public-read-write（公共读写）：所有用户都有该Bucket内的文件的读写权限。请谨慎使用该访问权限。 public-read（公共读）：Bucket的拥有者和授权用户有该Bucket内的文件的读写权限，其他用户只有该Bucket内的文件的读权限。请谨慎使用该访问权限。 private：Bucket的拥有者和授权用户有该Bucket内的文件的读写权限，其他用户没有权限操作该Bucket内的文件
